An agent confirms a time by email the same day. Can you help with a mortgage? We do not lend ourselves, but every office works with local banks and brokers and can introduce you. Do I pay a fee as a buyer? No. Our fee is paid by the seller, so our advice to buyers is free. Renting What do I need to rent a home? Usually an ID, proof of income and a reference from a past landlord. Your agent tells you exactly what each landlord asks for. How much is the deposit?
